title: Level 1 (Beginner) - B-9
notes:
West leads the ♠4 against 6NT. South starts with 11 top tricks (2 spades, 3 hearts, 4 diamonds, and 2 clubs). If West has led away from the ♠Q, South can get his twelfth trick immediately by playing the ♠J from the dummy.

If East has the ♠Q, however, he will cover dummy's ♠J with the ♠Q and the contract will not be certain. South can guarantee his contract by playing the ♠3 from dummy at trick 1. If East plays low, South will be able to take a trick with his ♠9. If East plays the ♠Q, the ♠J will be worth a trick.

If East plays the ♠10, South can win the ♠A or ♠K and lead back his ♠2. North's now singleton ♠J will force the ♠Q and the ♠9 will provide trick number 12.
